capabilities: Look up a selected or double-clicked word and get the meaning that fits the sentence
Translate phrases or whole passages sentence by sentence and ask questions about them
Work inside Obsidian's PDF viewer, including control-hover lookup
Save lookups to a review note or insert meanings inline
extras: Source code is kept in a private repository, with only release files public. The plugin is free, but Google's APIs may charge according to your Google plan. API keys are stored in the vault's plugin data.json and will travel with the vault if it is synced or shared. No ads, analytics or telemetry; a privacy policy is linked externally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up or translate a word or passage while reading, especially inside its PDF viewer.

relations.evidence: Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com): the text you look up
Cloud Translation API (translation.googleapis.com), only if you add its key
Cloud Text-to-Speech API (texttospeech.googleapis.com), only if you choose Google's voices

requires.name: Gemini API key from Google AI Studio
Google account to create the Gemini key

summary: AI-powered lookup that explains English words, phrases and passages in context with translation, IPA and read-aloud, and saves results to a note.
